verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs say DLSS Super Resolution, DLAA, Ray Reconstruction and Multi Frame Generation (up to five generated frames per rendered frame, with dynamic multipliers) run on RTX 50 Series. The NVIDIA app can update hundreds of games to the latest DLSS features, and Tom's Hardware's hands-on review exercised MFG on the 5090. Its latency caveat qualifies the experience but does not contradict that the feature works. missing for 10: an independently verified or specific supported-game list beyond the vendor's 'hundreds of games' claim, and independent evidence on how well frame generation handles input latency.
